outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of an H&E micrograph and spatial transcriptomic maps (heatmap-style overlays on tissue), not a bar chart or averaged plot requiring individual data points.
Panel B shows H&E and RNAscope micrograph images only; it is not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C is a scatter plot showing individual patient data points (each dot = one tumor sample) with median and 95% CI overlaid; individual values are the data itself.
Panel D is a bar chart (mean ± SD) with individual replicate data points overlaid as dots for each of the four groups.
